'''Sir Reginald of Stormwind''' is a human located at the [[Jousting Grounds]] in [[Northwind]]. One of the participants in the Northwind jousting tournament representing the [[Stormwind (kingdom)|kingdom of Stormwind]], he faces off against Sir [[Rudolf of Strom]].
